note: The pair track maps a CALLER node to a SCIP definition by the same rule (def-slack-own-node, SPEC v6.0; PR #79 round 3). The patch moves Beta.Run's node to line 14, one line above its own definition (15), and gives it a call edge on line 14. The caller window [12, 14] holds only Alpha.Run's definition (13), which Alpha.Run's own node holds: the caller must not map to Alpha.Run (no `Run -> Path` subject pair), and with no definition of its own in the window it is left unmapped rather than charged to the container around line 14.
